title: Rami bar Shmuel
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He was Rav Huna’s student, as in Niddah 17a: he and Rav Yitzchak son of Rav Huna were studying Niddah in Rav Huna’s school; Rabbah son of Rav Huna found them and came and told his father.
In Ketubot 97a he raised a difficulty against Rav Nachman, saying to him: “If so, you will cause them to stumble in the future.”

notes.text: The supplied Niddah locator 17a and companion’s father Huna are retained. The William Davidson digital Niddah 17b instead names Rav Yitzchak son of Rav Yehudah. In Ketubot 97a the quoted objection is explicitly Rami bar Shmuel’s to Rav Nachman; וא״ל in Hyman’s compressed paraphrase can continue with the same speaker. The English does not invent an opposite reply.
